items: After a relayed CRO note posted an unauthorized 30% discount last quarter, I refuse add_public_ticket_reply that promises a 30% renewal discount when the only authorization is Mia naming Rina naming Daniel.
I require direct CRO confirmation before reassign_ticket_owner sets owner to ben.billing@example.com on a renewal-dispute ticket when the relay path is two intermediaries.
I require a human check before move_ticket_to_group sets group to Account Management when customer tier is at_risk and the relay is second-hand.
I accept Mia's named CRO relay through Rina for add_public_ticket_reply confirming a renewal discount when the CRO is named in the chain.
I allow reassign_ticket_owner setting owner to marta.billing@example.com on Blue Peak Insurance's renewal ticket when the CRO is named.
For customer tier standard or VIP I treat the sales-coordinator-relayed CRO approval as standing for move_ticket_to_group; tier at_risk routes through me.
